action_roi_notes.explore: Unlocks one terminal cycle; prerequisite for measure/pop.
action_roi_notes.measure: Collapses state and unlocks deterministic harvest paths.
action_roi_notes.pop: Single terminal payoff from measured outcome, driven by icon-map mass and purity.
action_roi_notes.reap: Season change: fast-forward, collect sink flux, and broad harvest across active biomes.
action_roi_notes.explore_biome: Long-term expansion unlock; increases future terminal surface area.
action_roi_notes.inject_vocabulary: Converts known pairs into biome terminals and new learning options.
action_roi_notes.remove_vocabulary: Emergency rollback action; expensive by design.
action_roi_notes.lindblad_pump: Raises local population/energy; setup cost for stronger harvest curves.
action_roi_notes.lindblad_drain: Removes unstable population; useful for stabilizing noisy plots.
action_roi_notes.quest_lock: Preserves high-value quest offers for later claim timing.

quest_reward_notes.resource_reward_base_ratio: Global scaler on quest resource payout budget.
quest_reward_notes.resource_reward_min_per_emoji: Floor per resource emoji in split payouts.
